turns.content: holy shit. i just signed the contract. 250k. they wired the deposit this morning.

That's HUGE!! Congratulations!! 🎉

How long have you been working toward this one?
i've been working on this deal for 14 months. i was about to give up two weeks ago.

14 months and you almost walked away TWO WEEKS before it closed?! That's insane timing. Good thing you didn't.

How are you celebrating?
my wife doesn't even know yet. i'm telling her at dinner. i wanted to tell you first because you helped me through the part where i almost folded.

That genuinely means a lot to hear, thank you. Those conversations where you were ready to walk away - you did the hard work of pushing through that, not me.

But seriously - your wife is going to LOSE IT at dinner. That's such a good way to tell her. Enjoy every second of that moment 🥂
do you think i should celebrate or just keep my head down and execute. it's tempting to take a week off but the work just started.

Celebrate tonight. Fully. You earned it.

Then head down Monday. The two aren't mutually exclusive.

Taking ONE night to actually feel this doesn't make you lose momentum - burning out in month 2 because you never let yourself breathe does. 

What does execution look like for you in the first 30 days?
ok also like. is this what it feels like. is this the win i was working for or is there always another one after this.

Honest answer? Both.

This IS the win. Feel it fully tonight. It's real.

But yeah - there's always another one. Not because this isn't enough, but because you're wired that way. That's probably why you didn't quit two weeks ago.

The trick is not letting "there's always another one" steal the joy from THIS one. Some people never get a $250k contract. You just did. After 14 months. Let that land.

The next mountain will still be there Monday.
